description: Check a draft podcast script before recording: hard errors, listener-quality warnings (hook, stakes, pacing, repetition) tied to turn numbers, word count and estimated length, and whether it is long enough to publish automatically. Pass the turns in speaking order. Nothing is recorded or stored.

turns.description: The script, one item per spoken turn, in order.

text.description: What this speaker says. A recorded turn holds up to 5000 characters.

name: validate_episode_script

below_auto_publish_floor.description: True if the episode is short enough that it may be saved as a draft instead of published.

errors.description: Hard blockers; fix these before recording.

code.description: Stable issue code, e.g. missing_stakes or turn_too_long.

message.description: What is wrong, in plain words.

turn_index.description: Zero-based turn the issue belongs to, or null for the whole script.
